name: soirely
description: Event management for the people running the event.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:php && npm run lint:actions
scripts.lint:api: docker compose exec -T api php vendor/bin/mago lint
scripts.analyse:api: docker compose exec -T api php vendor/bin/mago analyze
scripts.guard:api: docker compose exec -T api php vendor/bin/mago guard && node scripts/check-migrations.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test:api && npm run test:packages
scripts.test:api: docker compose exec -T api sh -c "APP_ENV=test vendor/bin/phpunit"
scripts.format: npm run format:js && npm run format:php
scripts.fix:api: docker compose exec -T api php vendor/bin/mago fix --no-fmt
